description: Opaque rust-red floor-length wool overdress with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves, over a cream linen underdress. Narrow tan-gold geometric woven trim outlines the neckline, cuffs, vertical front and hem. A narrow plain brown leather waist belt closes with a small round metal buckle. An olive-brown patterned shawl rests along both forearms and hangs down the sides, with subtle geometric borders. Cream underdress appears at the wrists and through the lower front opening. Brown closed leather footwear is visible at the hem. The fabric is textured and practical. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
